headline: Toured a farm's hoop houses, fields, and outbuildings; no policy discussions or decisions were made.
summary: Members toured the farm, including its hoop houses, fields, and various outbuildings. The tour was led by the farm manager. No policy discussions or decisions were made during the tour.

180 Market Street, South Burlington, Vermont | 802-846-4107 | www.southburlingtonvt.gov 
MINUTES 
 CITY COUNCIL 
           28 October 2026 
 
The South Burlington City Council held a Facilities Tour on Wednesday, 28 
October, at 8:00 a.m., starting at the Common Roots Farmstand in South Village.   
 
Pursuant to the field visit exemption under Vermont’s Open Meeting Law, the site 
visits were not recorded, and no virtual attendance option was provided. 1 V.S.A. 
§ 312(a)(6)(A) and(a)(6)(j)(1) 
MEMBERS PRESENT: T. Barritt, Chair; E. Fitzgerald, L. Smith, A. Chalnick,  
 
ALSO PRESENT: J. Baker, City Manager; Colin O’Brien, Common Roots Farm 
Manager; Carol MCQuillen, Co-Founder and Director of Common Roots; Jeff 
Caulkin, Board of Common Roots    
 
1. Open Meeting 
 
The meeting was called to order at 8:03 by Councilor Barritt.  
 
2. Additions, deletions or changes in the order of Agenda items: 
 
No changes were made to the Agenda. 
 
3. Comments and questions from the public not related to the agenda: 
 
No comments were made 
 
4. Receive a tour of the Farm at South Village from Colin O'Brien, 
Common Roots Farm Manager. No policy discussions or decisions were 
made during these tours.
180 Market Street, South Burlington, Vermont | 802-846-4107 | www.southburlingtonvt.gov 
The Council received a tour of the farm including the hoop houses, fields, and 
various out buildings.    
 
5. Other Business 
 
No other business was discussed 
 
As there was no further business to come before the Council Ms. Fitzgerald 
moved to adjourn.  Mr. Smith seconded.  Motion passed unanimously.  The 
meeting was adjourned at 9:05 a.m.
